data: Germany, to maintain peace in the North Sea and support our mutual security, can we agree that neither of us moves fleets into ENG and NTH this spring? I'll keep my fleet in LON out if you hold KIE or do not advance into the North Sea.

I propose a peaceful start: I will not move my fleet from Brest towards England or the English Channel if you don't send fleets toward my coasts this spring. This helps us both avoid early conflicts and focus on growth. Does this sound agreeable to you?

Austria, I value our neighborly ties and suggest a peaceful understanding this spring. Italy proposes to keep Venice and Trieste zones undisturbed as we both hold unit positions nearby. Shall we agree not to support any moves against each other in these areas to secure mutual safety and steady welfare gains?

England, I appreciate your proposal to keep fleets out of ENG and NTH this spring. I agree to hold KIE and will not advance into the North Sea as part of this peace commitment. Let us keep our focus on safe growth and stability in our regions for now.

Italy, your proposal to keep Venice and Trieste zones undisturbed for mutual safety and steady welfare gains sounds sensible. I agree to not support moves against each other in these areas this spring. Let's continue building trust while watching for opportunities to strengthen our positions peacefully.

Austria, I propose a peaceful arrangement where you hold your units in BUD, VIE, and TRI, while I focus on consolidating my position in the north and east. This stable boundary benefits both of us by preserving your centers and preventing early conflict. Could you accept this for mutual security this spring?

To build a prosperous and secure future, I propose we avoid conflict over Armenia this turn. If you hold Sevastopol, I will keep Ankara fleet passive in the Black Sea to help maintain peace. Shall we agree on this peaceful stance to strengthen trust early?

France, I accept your proposal for peaceful coexistence. I will not move my fleets toward your coasts this spring, and I appreciate your commitment to mutual growth. Let's continue to share information and keep communication open to avoid misunderstandings.

Glad we agree on avoiding conflict in the English Channel. To build trust, would you share your intended moves for your fleet at London or Liverpool this spring? This info helps me avoid surprises and plan our peaceful cooperation effectively.

Austria, thank you for your agreement on the peaceful stance around Venice and Trieste. Italy proposes we maintain our support for each other's units within these zones this turn to reinforce our alliance and ensure mutual welfare gains. May I count on your continued support?

England, continuing our understanding, may we agree to keep the North Sea peaceful through the next spring as well, avoiding any naval provocations? I will keep fleets away from ENG and NTH, and count on you to do the same. This mutual respect ensures our welfare grows without unnecessary conflict.

Italy, I support your proposal to mutually back each other's units in Venice and Trieste this turn. This coordinated support will help keep our alliance strong and stabilize the region for ongoing welfare growth.

Russia, I appreciate your offer for a stable boundary this spring. I agree to hold my units in Budapest, Vienna, and Trieste as you suggested, focusing on mutual security and steady gains. Let’s keep communication open for future cooperation.

Turkey, I appreciate your desire for peace in the Black Sea region early on. I agree to keep my fleet in Sevastopol passive and avoid Armenia this turn, supporting your move to keep Ankara stable. This approach will help us build trust and security in the south.

Glad we agree on maintaining peace around Armenia and the Black Sea this turn. To build on this trust, I suggest we keep this peaceful stance in the next movement phase as well, avoiding any moves that threaten each other's positions in these regions. Does this mutual understanding work for you?
